capabilities: Render Kanban boards from Bases or frontmatter notes
Write drag, reschedule and resize changes back to notes
Show calendar, Gantt, outline, pivot, gallery and feed views
Compute formulas, roll-ups and saved filters
disambiguation: Not a registered Bases view; it is a standalone plugin that reads the vault directly, so it can also index inline fields and checkbox lines.
extras: Freemium: Lite gives a Kanban board with drag, inline and bulk edit, search and Markdown export; calendar, Gantt, dashboard, pivot, gallery, feed, analytics, formulas, roll-ups, Move Rules, CSV export, inline key:: value fields, task rows, link traversal, FLATTEN and the Dataview converter are license-gated. License key is emailed after a $29 one-time Buy Me a Coffee purchase and unlocks offline with no account. Optional indexing switches each cost a pass over the notes. Support is tracked only via the GitHub issue tracker.
intentEvidence: Most Bases boards only display your notes. Bases Power Pack writes the changes back
problem: Bases views only display notes, so moving a card or rescheduling a date still means opening each note and editing frontmatter by hand.

relations.evidence: no Dataview, no cloud, no account
including the Tasks-plugin emoji shorthand (📅 🛫 ⏳ ✅ ⏫), updated in place

requires.name: Premium license key ($29 one-time, via Buy Me a Coffee)

summary: Kanban, calendar, Gantt and other database views for Bases that write card moves and date changes back to note frontmatter.
